questions.q_en: In a ABC, D, E and F are the mid-points of side BC, CA and AB respectively. If BC = 25.6 cm, CA = 18.8 cm and AB = 20.4 cm, what is the perimeter [in cm] of the DEF?
questions.q_hi: ∆ABC में, D, E और F क्रमशः भुजाओं BC, CA और AB के मध्य-बिंदु हैं। यदि BC = 25.6 सेमी, CA = 18.8 सेमी और AB = 20.4 सेमी है, तो ΔDEF का परिमाप [सेमी में] क्या है?
questions.solution_en:
Perimeter of Δ at midpoints = [Perimeter of Δ]
Perimeter of △DEF = [20.4 + 25.6 + 18.8]
= × 64.8
Perimeter of △DEF = 32.4cm
questions.solution_hi:
मध्यबिंदुओं पर Δ का परिमाप = [Δ का परिमाप]
△DEF का परिमाप = [20.4 + 25.6 + 18.8]
= × 64.8
△DEF का परिमाप = 32.4 सेमी

questions.q_en: What is the sum of the numbers between 400 and 500 such that when they are divided by 6,12 and 16, it leaves no remainder?

questions.solution_en:
L.C.M of [6,12,16]=48
Multiples of 48 between 400 and 500 = 432,480
∴ Sum = 432+480 = 912
questions.solution_hi:
[6,12,16] का L.C.M = 48
400 और 500 के बीच 48 के गुणज = 432,480
∴ योग = 432+480 = 912
